name: Functions vs Mechanisms
title: Functions vs Mechanisms
description: Functions describe what: 'convert rotation to linear motion'. Mechanisms describe how: 'lead screw', 'rack and pinion', 'cam'. Confusing them locks design prematurely.
how_it_works: State functions solution-neutrally, then explore mechanisms. Never let a mechanism masquerade as a function ('we need a lead screw' vs 'we need linear motion').
requirements: Defined functions in solution-neutral terms; a library of mechanism types; mapping rationale.
